categories.main_business_segments: Genpact operates through three primary business segments, which are also its reportable segments: (1) Banking, Capital Markets and Insurance (BCMI), (2) Consumer Goods, Retail, Life Sciences and Healthcare (CGRLH), and (3) High Tech, Manufacturing and Services (HMS). These segments reflect the company's focus on delivering domain-led solutions tailored to specific industry verticals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Genpact leverages its proprietary Digital Smart Enterprise Processes (Digital SEPs), which combine Lean Six Sigma methodologies with advanced digital technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), analytics, and automation. The company’s Genpact Cora platform integrates automation, analytics, and AI, while its Enterprise360 intelligence platform uses AI for prescriptive actions and operational insights. Genpact also employs cloud-based solutions, robotic process automation, and human-centric design in its transformation services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Genpact serves over 700 clients, including about one-fifth of the Fortune Global 500, across a range of industries. Key customer groups include large enterprises in banking and financial services, insurance, consumer goods, retail, life sciences, healthcare, high tech, manufacturing, and services. General Electric (GE) has historically been a significant client, accounting for 9% of 2021 revenues.
categories.geographic_coverage: Genpact operates globally with delivery centers in 22 countries and employees in over 30 countries. Major regions include North America (especially the United States), Europe (notably the UK and EU), Asia (with a significant presence in India and the Philippines), and other locations such as Australia, Latin America, and Africa. Over 70% of revenues are derived from North America, with more than 15% from Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Genpact primarily operates as a downstream service provider, delivering business process management, digital transformation, analytics, and IT services directly to end customers and enterprise clients. It acts as a strategic partner in clients’ value chains, focusing on process optimization, digital enablement, and operational transformation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Genpact’s strategic focus is on domain-led digital transformation, investing in differentiated solutions for targeted industry verticals and geographies. The company prioritizes innovation in AI, analytics, cloud, and experience-led transformation, and invests in employee learning and development to build future-ready skills. Recent acquisitions have expanded capabilities in digital experience, data analytics, and cloud technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Genpact generates revenue primarily through long-term contracts for business process outsourcing, transformation services, consulting, and IT services. Revenue models include time-and-materials, transaction-based, and fixed-price contracts, as well as software-as-a-service (SaaS) and licensing for digital platforms. The company also earns revenue from advisory and analytics services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Genpact competes with large multinational service providers (such as Accenture, Cognizant, Infosys, Wipro, and WNS), IT and business process outsourcing firms, and niche providers. The company differentiates itself through deep domain expertise, digital transformation capabilities, and global delivery. It is recognized as a leading provider in finance and accounting services and is positioned as a strategic partner for digital-led business transformation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2021, Genpact reported total net revenues of $4.0 billion, representing 8.4% year-over-year growth (7.2% on a constant currency basis). The company has over 109,600 employees and a global client base. Net income for 2021 was $369 million, with a gross margin of 35.6% and an adjusted operating income margin of 16.5%. The company has demonstrated consistent growth, driven by expansion in transformation services and intelligent operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Genpact’s value proposition centers on delivering domain-led, digitally enabled transformation that drives measurable business outcomes for clients, such as improved productivity, enhanced customer experience, and operational excellence. The company differentiates itself through its proprietary digital platforms, deep industry expertise, and ability to combine process knowledge with advanced analytics and AI. Genpact emphasizes rapid prototyping, human-centric design, and the ability to scale digital solutions globally.
